title: Quick Start
subtitle: Forms with fine-grained field updates
description: useResource + useField for a responsive React form — then level up to Zod, arrays, and bound hooks.
content: Keep the shell on useResource for save/status. Put each input in a child that calls useField so keystrokes stay local.

code.code:
npm install qortex-resource-react@0.1.0-alpha.0
# qortex-resource installs automatically · peer: react ^18.2

sections.title: 4. Bound hooks (no props)
sections.content: For a single screen, factory hooks remove prop drilling. See Dynamic Identity for productId params.
